name: io.github.growthbook/growthbook-mcp
description: Thin MCP server for GrowthBook — skill loader + authenticated API passthrough

environmentVariables.description: A GrowthBook API key or personal access token.
environmentVariables.name: GB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Your GrowthBook API URL. Defaults to https://api.growthbook.io.
environmentVariables.name: GB_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable bundled skill tools (growthbook_list_skills, growthbook_read_skill). Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: GB_SKILLS_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Custom HTTP headers via GB_HTTP_HEADER_<NAME> (e.g. GB_HTTP_HEADER_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN).
environmentVariables.name: GB_HTTP_HEADER_*
